description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system used in Android development. It specifies a method for logging messages with various levels, tags, messages, and optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output log data to multiple targets. It supports chaining log nodes and defining custom log processing.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for error reporting.
